events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: English actor, comedian, screenwriter, and film producer John Cleese celebrates his 87th birthday today.

angles.name: Python to Fawlty Towers
angles.copy: From Monty Python's surreal sketches to the iconic Basil Fawlty, John Cleese turns 87 today. Which of his legendary roles makes you laugh the most?

events.title: The Beatles' 'White Album' anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their ninth studio album, commonly known as 'The White Album', in 1968.

angles.name: Revolutionary sound
angles.copy: Fifty-eight years since its release, The Beatles' 'White Album' still sounds as groundbreaking as ever. A double LP packed with diverse tracks, what's your standout song?

events.title: Remembering Freddie Mercury, would have been 80
events.blurb: Today marks the anniversary of the passing of Queen frontman, Freddie Mercury, who would have been 80 this year.

angles.name: A true showman
angles.copy: Remembering the incomparable Freddie Mercury, who would have been 80 today. His stage presence and vocal power remain unmatched. What's your favourite Queen anthem?

events.title: The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their sixth studio album, 'Rubber Soul', in 1965.

angles.name: Folk-rock masterpiece
angles.copy: Sixty-one years ago, The Beatles dropped 'Rubber Soul', an album that marked a significant shift in their sound. Which track still resonates with you?

events.title: Remembering John Lennon, would have been 86
events.blurb: Today marks the anniversary of the passing of The Beatles' co-founder, John Lennon, who would have been 86 this year.

angles.name: Imagine his legacy
angles.copy: On this day, we remember John Lennon, a visionary artist who would have been 86. His music and message of peace continue to inspire. What's your favourite Lennon song?

events.title: David Bowie would have been 80
events.blurb: Legendary musician and cultural icon David Bowie would have celebrated his 80th birthday today.

angles.name: Starman's 80th
angles.copy: The Starman would have turned 80 today. David Bowie's influence on music, fashion, and culture is simply immeasurable. Which Bowie era is your favourite?

events.title: Elvis Presley would have been 92
events.blurb: The 'King of Rock and Roll', Elvis Presley, would have celebrated his 92nd birthday today.

angles.name: Long live the King
angles.copy: The King of Rock and Roll, Elvis Presley, would have been 92 today. His impact on music is undeniable. What's the first Elvis song that comes to mind?

events.title: Jimmy Page turns 83
events.blurb: Led Zeppelin guitarist and music producer Jimmy Page celebrates his 83rd birthday.

angles.name: Guitar God at 83
angles.copy: Happy 83rd birthday to the legendary Jimmy Page! The Led Zeppelin mastermind continues to inspire guitarists worldwide. What's his most iconic riff?

events.title: Rod Stewart turns 82
events.blurb: Iconic British singer and songwriter Rod Stewart celebrates his 82nd birthday.

angles.name: Rocker's 82nd
angles.copy: Still rocking after all these years! Sir Rod Stewart turns 82 today. What's your favourite track from his incredible career?

events.title: Suggs turns 66
events.blurb: Graham McPherson, better known as Suggs, the lead singer of Madness, celebrates his 66th birthday.

angles.name: Madness frontman's birthday
angles.copy: Our House, in the middle of our feed! Happy 66th birthday to Suggs, the iconic frontman of Madness. What's your go-to Madness track?

events.title: Paul Young turns 71
events.blurb: British singer-songwriter Paul Young, known for hits like 'Wherever I Lay My Hat', celebrates his 71st birthday.

angles.name: Wherever he lays his hat
angles.copy: Happy 71st birthday to Paul Young! The voice behind some of the biggest 80s hits. What's your favourite Paul Young classic?

events.title: Dolly Parton turns 81
events.blurb: Country music legend, singer, songwriter, and businesswoman Dolly Parton celebrates her 81st birthday.

angles.name: Queen of Country at 81
angles.copy: From humble beginnings to global icon, Dolly Parton celebrates her 81st birthday today! An incredible songwriter and philanthropist. What's your favourite Dolly hit?

events.title: Gary Barlow turns 56
events.blurb: Take That frontman, singer, songwriter, and television personality Gary Barlow celebrates his 56th birthday.

angles.name: Take That's leader turns 56
angles.copy: Happy 56th birthday to the one and only Gary Barlow! From Take That anthems to his solo hits, he's written some absolute classics. What's your favourite Gary-penned song?

events.title: Billy Ocean turns 77
events.blurb: Trinidadian-British singer Billy Ocean, known for his string of 80s hits, celebrates his 77th birthday.

angles.name: Caribbean Queen's 77th
angles.copy: Get out your dancing shoes, because Billy Ocean turns 77 today! The voice behind 'Caribbean Queen' and 'When the Going Gets Tough'. What's your favourite track?

events.title: Rock & Roll Hall of Fame's first ceremony
events.blurb: The first induction ceremony for the Rock and Roll Hall of Fame was held in 1989, honouring pioneers like Elvis Presley and The Beatles.

angles.name: Making history in music
angles.copy: Thirty-eight years ago, the Rock & Roll Hall of Fame held its inaugural induction. A momentous day for music history, celebrating the legends that shaped sound. Who do you think should be inducted next?

events.title: Mark Owen turns 55
events.blurb: Take That member Mark Owen, singer and songwriter, celebrates his 55th birthday.

angles.name: Take That's Mark Owen at 55
angles.copy: Happy 55th birthday to Mark Owen! From his Take That days to his solo career, he's always brought the charm. What's your favourite Mark Owen moment?

events.title: The Beatles' iconic Rooftop Concert anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles performed their final public performance on the rooftop of Apple Corps headquarters in London in 1969.

angles.name: A legendary final performance
angles.copy: Fifty-eight years ago today, The Beatles made history with their iconic rooftop concert. A truly unforgettable moment in music. If you could have been there, who would you have gone with?

events.title: Phil Collins turns 76
events.blurb: English drummer, singer, songwriter, and record producer Phil Collins celebrates his 76th birthday.

angles.name: Drummer, singer, legend
angles.copy: Happy 76th birthday to the incredible Phil Collins! From Genesis to his massive solo career, he's given us so many unforgettable songs. What's your favourite?

events.title: Hugh Grant turns 67
events.blurb: Celebrated British actor Hugh Grant, known for his romantic comedy roles, celebrates his 67th birthday.

angles.name: Charming Hugh at 67
angles.copy: Happy 67th birthday to the charming Hugh Grant! From 'Four Weddings' to 'Notting Hill', his roles have defined a generation of British rom-coms. What's your favourite Hugh Grant film?

events.title: Justin Timberlake turns 46
events.blurb: American singer, songwriter, actor, and record producer Justin Timberlake celebrates his 46th birthday.

angles.name: JT's 46th birthday
angles.copy: From *NSYNC heartthrob to solo superstar, Justin Timberlake turns 46 today! He's still bringing sexy back. What's your favourite JT track?

events.title: Sir David Jason turns 87
events.blurb: Beloved English actor Sir David Jason, famous for roles like Del Boy and Jack Frost, celebrates his 87th birthday.

angles.name: Lovely Jubbly at 87
angles.copy: To me, to you! Happy 87th birthday to the national treasure, Sir David Jason. From Del Boy to Frost, his characters are etched in British TV history. What's your favourite role?

events.title: Remembering 'The Day The Music Died'
events.blurb: Today marks the anniversary of the tragic 1959 plane crash that claimed the lives of rock and roll pioneers Buddy Holly, Ritchie Valens, and The Big Bopper.

angles.name: A somber anniversary
angles.copy: Sixty-eight years ago today, we lost Buddy Holly, Ritchie Valens, and The Big Bopper in 'The Day The Music Died'. A tragic loss that changed rock and roll forever.
